test_item_verbatim: When the HU receives the $RVC_SK_PRSNT$ = [Present] the HU shall activate the virtual Rear View Camera button for user select-ability.

tcs.tc_title: RVC_SK_PRSNT present, read the App Drawer and check that "Rear View Camera" is present and selectable
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The shift lever is in P
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Apps" on Menu Bar to open App Drawer
2. Read the App Drawer and check that "Rear View Camera" is present and selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. The App Drawer is displayed
2. The "Rear View Camera" entry is present in the App Drawer and can be selected
tcs.test_item:
When the HU receives the $RVC_SK_PRSNT$ = [Present] the HU shall activate the virtual Rear View Camera button for user select-ability.

(RVC_SK_PRSNT present, read the App Drawer and check that "Rear View Camera" is present and selectable)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 CFTS092 SYS-RA-CAM-072（ObjectID 4781637）之「$RVC_SK_PRSNT$ = [Present] 時啟用虛擬 Rear View Camera 鍵」。錨取 Rear Camera 節（R-CAM12）。$RVC_SK_PRSNT$ 為設定／參數標記，其車輛組態對應為 PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)（五平台 byte 86 bit 0 實測），故以該 PROXI 行表達前提。缺件側（Absent）不在本 Test Set 之範圍，屬 Configuration（SWE-CAM-002／-005）。
